Complete-positive domination by that identity component and operator monotonicity of the logarithm give an amortized relative-entropy upper bound, saturated by a maximally entangled input. The source fixed-resolution variational theorem then leaves a scalar ratio of a strictly concave function, whose maximum is at the minimum allowed duration. This proves the closed profile and the unrestricted limit; the series follows from an analytic Taylor expansion. The packaged checker only corroborates these exact steps.
